protocol.name: reprise_caption_v1
protocol.copyright: reprise private protocol: what a program's window shows on the caption Reprise draws for it.

interface.name: reprise_caption_v1

description.summary: choose what a toplevel's caption shows

interface.description: One global. A program whose window names its place in its own client area asks for the caption Reprise draws over it to leave out the window icon and the title. The title still names the window everywhere else: its taskbar button, the window switcher, the window menu and screen readers. The caption buttons stay, and the window menu still opens on Alt+Space and on a click at the caption's left end, where the icon was.

entry.name: full
entry.summary: the window icon and the title

entry.name: bare
entry.summary: neither the window icon nor the title

request.name: set
request.description: Asked before toplevel maps, it holds from the map on. A window in a tab group shows its tabs' titles whatever it asked for. An unknown style is full. Ignored when toplevel belongs to another client.
